newsitem.title: UK: UK firm bids for Italy's Vicenza soccer club.
newsitem.headline: UK firm bids for Italy's Vicenza soccer club.

text.p: British investment company Stellican is bidding for top Italian football club Vicenza, the Times newspaper said.
In its Thursday edition, the Times said Stellican would find out on Friday whether its 8.0 million stg bid for the Italian Cup winners has been successful.
The report said Stellican specialised in buying distressed companies. Vicenza is in the hands of a bankruptcy court after its owning family's textile company folded, the Times said.

Stellican has already outbid two local rival consortia but they are allowed to present new bids to the court this week. Stellican in turn is given the chance to match those bids if it wants, the report said.
